title: Airreach
description: A Lightweight Create And Cobblemon Modpack
body:
A Simple Create and Cobblemon pack focusing on Create Aeronautics with minor aditons and improvments to both




# DESCRIPTION
![An Airship](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2fdemDN1/images/69507801101e530eed7f8d18c9752baf836b3181.png)


a lightweight modpack with create Aeronautics and cobblemon with vanilla plus tweaks and farming and create addons, like create structures arise, create propulsion, create interiors and farmers delight. 


was created to play with friends
